problem_statement: A parent accepts malformed Address Registration TLVs whose compressed or uncompressed address entries are incomplete. Truncated entries must produce a parse error and cause Child Update Requests to be rejected rather than treated as successfully processed. Valid compressed and uncompressed registrations, empty and absent registrations, and unrelated child address mappings must retain their existing behavior. Preserve existing MLE and dataset behavior.
build_command: cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DOT_PLATFORM=external -DOT_BUILD_GTEST=ON -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DOT_APP_CLI=OFF -DOT_APP_NCP=OFF -DOT_APP_RCP=OFF -DOT_MTD=OFF -DOT_RCP=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DOT_LOG_LEVEL=WARN -DOT_LOG_OUTPUT=PLATFORM_DEFINED && cmake --build build --target ot-ftd-gtest ot-test-mle -j$(nproc)
orientation: Tests use the real OpenThread FTD core, upstream FakePlatform, and the upstream MLE unit-test platform. Run `run_tests` to configure, rebuild, and execute address-registration regressions and existing MLE/dataset controls. No radio hardware is needed. Tests under tests/ are protected.
